map.由生存人数求 t 年生存概率 使用指南: t-Year Survival Probability from Survivor Counts User Guide
map.输入生命表中 x 岁与 x+t 岁的生存人数 l_x、l_{x+t}，按 ₜp_: Enter the survivor counts l_x and l_{x+t} at ages x and x+t from a life table and compute the t-year survival probability as ₜp_x = l_{x+t}/l_x, used in actuarial derivations for multi-period survival benefits and joint-survival models.
map.输入 x+t 岁与 x 岁生存人数，求 t 年生存概率。: Enter the survivor counts at ages x+t and x to get the t-year survival probability.
map.由 x 岁与 x+t 岁存活人数 l 求 t 年生存概率 ₜpₓ。: Get the t-year survival probability ₜpₓ from the survivor counts l at age x and age x+t.
map.做养老金给付或保障期生存假设。: For pension benefit or survival assumptions over the coverage period.

map.ₜpₓ = pₓ·pₓ₊₁·…·pₓ₊ₜ₋₁，即逐年生存概率连乘；用 l 表直接: ₜpₓ = pₓ·pₓ₊₁·…·pₓ₊ₜ₋₁, the product of the annual survival probabilities; dividing the l-table values directly is more stable.
map.不能。生存概率是0到1之间的累积概率，由逐年生存概率连乘得到；若算得大于1 说明: No. A survival probability is a cumulative probability between 0 and 1, obtained by multiplying the annual survival probabilities; a value above 1 means the surviving count rose above the starting count, which is a data error to be checked.
